safe_auto_publish: clear title/meta corrections on existing URLs
broken internal-link fixes that preserve destination intent
alt-text corrections based on the actual image/project
small typo/grammar fixes with no change to business meaning
small evidence-based on-page improvements on existing URLs with no new claims
structured-data corrections using verified business facts only
approval_required: redirect creation/change/removal except a clearly broken legacy path with verified replacement
new guarantees or fixed completion durations
VAT, subsidy, permit, legal, insurance or regulatory claims
new business facts or unverified technical claims
removing an indexed URL from sitemap
forbidden_without_verification: inventing price ranges or labour rates
changing year-sensitive legal or subsidy information by simply replacing the year
